duas.title: On waking up
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah, who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the return.

duas.title: In the morning
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur
duas.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening. By You we live and by You we die, and to You is the return.

duas.title: For protection, morning and evening
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-sami'ul-'alim
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
duas.note: Said three times in the morning and three times in the evening.

duas.title: For patience and steady feet
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًۭا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ ﴿٢٥٠﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin
duas.translation: Our Lord, pour patience upon us, make our steps firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.

duas.title: For a steady heart
duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَىٰ دِينِكَ
duas.transliteration: Ya muqallibal-qulub, thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik
duas.translation: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm on Your religion.

duas.title: To stay guided
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ ﴿٨﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-Wahhab
duas.translation: Our Lord, do not let our hearts turn away after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from You. You are the Giver.

duas.title: For guidance and contentment
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَىٰ وَالتُّقَىٰ وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَىٰ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda wat-tuqa wal-'afafa wal-ghina
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and freedom from need.

duas.title: For ease and clear speech
duas.arabic: رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى ﴿٢٥﴾ وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى ﴿٢٦﴾ وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةًۭ مِّن لِّسَانِى ﴿٢٧﴾ يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى ﴿٢٨﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbish-rah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani, yafqahu qawli
duas.translation: My Lord, open my heart for me, make my task easy for me, and untie the knot from my tongue, so they understand my words.

duas.title: For knowledge
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma
duas.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.title: For worry and sadness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa dala'id-dayn, wa ghalabatir-rijal
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and sadness, from weakness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from the burden of debt, and from being overpowered by people.

duas.title: In times of distress
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-'Azimul-Halim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbul-'arshil-'azim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-'arshil-karim
duas.translation: There is no god but Allah, the Great, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Great Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

duas.title: The dua of Prophet Yunus
duas.arabic: لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ﴿٨٧﴾
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
duas.translation: There is no god but You. Glory be to You. I have been one of the wrongdoers.

duas.title: Asking for His mercy
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
duas.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi rahmatika astaghith
duas.translation: O Ever Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I call for help.

duas.title: After a loss
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. Allahumma'jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha
duas.translation: We belong to Allah and to Him we return. O Allah, reward me in my loss and replace it with something better.
duas.note: Narrated by Umm Salamah, who said this after losing her husband.

duas.title: When you are in need
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍۢ فَقِيرٌۭ ﴿٢٤﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir
duas.translation: My Lord, I am truly in need of whatever good You send down to me.

duas.title: Trusting Allah
duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ ﴿١٧٣﴾
duas.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil
duas.translation: Allah is enough for us, and He is the best Guardian.

duas.title: To be grateful
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ ﴿١٩﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakal-lati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa adkhilni birahmatika fi 'ibadikas-salihin
duas.translation: My Lord, help me be grateful for Your favor which You gave to me and to my parents, and to do good that pleases You. Admit me by Your mercy among Your righteous servants.

duas.title: Help me remember You
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَىٰ ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik
duas.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.

duas.title: For a loving family
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍۢ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا ﴿٧٤﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us joy in our spouses and children, and make us an example for those who are mindful of You.

duas.title: For a newly married couple
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.transliteration: Barakallahu laka, wa baraka 'alayka, wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr
duas.translation: May Allah bless you, send blessings upon you, and bring you both together in goodness.

duas.title: For your parents
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًۭا ﴿٢٤﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
duas.translation: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.

duas.title: For you and your children to pray
duas.arabic: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ ﴿٤٠﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbij-'alni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati, Rabbana wa taqabbal du'a
duas.translation: My Lord, make me one who keeps up the prayer, and my children too. Our Lord, accept my prayer.

duas.title: Forgiveness for your family
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ ﴿٤١﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanagh-fir li wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab
duas.translation: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day the account is taken.

duas.title: The dua of Maryam's mother
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ﴿٣٥﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbi inni nadhartu laka ma fi batni muharraran fataqabbal minni, innaka antas-Sami'ul-'Alim
duas.translation: My Lord, I have dedicated to You what is in my womb, devoted to Your service, so accept this from me. You are the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
duas.note: Said by the wife of 'Imran while she was pregnant with Maryam.

duas.title: For righteous children
duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةًۭ طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ ﴿٣٨﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka sami'ud-du'a
duas.translation: My Lord, grant me good children from You. You hear every prayer.

duas.title: Gratitude for your family
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ ﴿١٥﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakal-lati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa aslih li fi dhurriyyati, inni tubtu ilayka wa inni minal-muslimin
duas.translation: My Lord, help me be grateful for Your favor upon me and my parents, and to do good that pleases You. Make my children good. I turn to You, and I am one of those who submit to You.
duas.note: This verse begins by describing a mother carrying and nursing her child.

duas.title: The best way to ask forgiveness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u laka bidhanbi faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I keep Your covenant and promise as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil I have done. I admit Your favors upon me and I admit my sins, so forgive me, for no one forgives sins except You.
duas.note: Known as Sayyid al-Istighfar, the best way to ask forgiveness.

duas.title: The dua of Adam and Hawwa
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ ﴿٢٣﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.

duas.title: In the last nights of Ramadan
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni
duas.translation: O Allah, You are the One who pardons, and You love to pardon, so pardon me.
duas.note: Taught by the Prophet to 'Aishah for Laylat al-Qadr.

duas.title: For forgiveness and mercy
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ ﴿١١٨﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbigh-fir warham wa anta khayrur-rahimin
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of those who show mercy.

duas.title: Ayat al-Kursi
duas.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌۭ وَلَا نَوْمٌۭ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ﴿٢٥٥﴾
duas.translation: Allah, there is no god but Him, the Ever Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they grasp nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and guarding them does not tire Him. He is the Most High, the Most Great.

duas.title: When you stop at a place
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

duas.title: Surah Al-Falaq
duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾
duas.translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.

duas.title: Surah An-Nas
duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
duas.translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of people, the King of people, the God of people, from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, who whispers in the hearts of people, from among jinn and people.

duas.title: Before sleeping
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya
duas.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.title: Lying down to sleep
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You raise Your servants.
duas.note: The Prophet would place his right hand under his cheek and say this.

duas.title: Surah Al-Ikhlas
duas.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ ﴿٤﴾
duas.translation: Say, He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor was born, and there is none comparable to Him.
duas.note: The Prophet would recite Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas before sleeping (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017).

duas.title: The dua of Asiyah
duas.arabic: رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ﴿١١﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbibni li 'indaka baytan fil-jannah, wa najjini min Fir'awna wa 'amalih, wa najjini minal-qawmiz-zalimin
duas.translation: My Lord, build for me a home near You in Paradise, and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds, and save me from the wrongdoing people.
duas.note: Said by Asiyah, the wife of Pharaoh, whom Allah gives as an example for the believers.

duas.title: For good in both lives
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةًۭ وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةًۭ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ﴿٢٠١﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

dhikr.translation: There is no god but Allah
Glory be to Allah and all praise is His

dhikr.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
dhikr.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
dhikr.translation: There is no power and no strength except with Allah
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad
